description: This file defines the JsonCodec class which implements multiple serialization-related interfaces for serializing and deserializing objects using System.Text.Json within the Orleans framework. It includes constructors, methods for writing and reading fields, type support checks, deep copying, and internal utilities. The class is a key component for JSON serialization in the Orleans serialization ecosystem.

classes.name: JsonCodec
classes.description: A serialization codec that uses System.Text.Json to serialize, deserialize, and copy objects, supporting type filtering and integration within the Orleans serialization framework.

methods.name: JsonCodec
methods.description: Constructor initializing the JSON codec with type selectors, copier selectors, and options.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a field of an object into a writer, handling references, type info, and JSON payload.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a value from a reader, handling type info, references, and JSON payload.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Determines if a given type is supported for serialization/deserialization by this codec.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an object using JSON serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: IsTypeAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a type is allowed based on support in this codec or copier.
